name: South Carolina
agency: South Carolina Department of Motor Vehicles (SCDMV)
permitAge: 15 (beginner’s permit), enrolled in or finished approved driver education; parent or guardian signs under 18 (secondary sources)

teen.supervisedHours: 40 hours, including 10 in darkness, certified by a parent or guardian (secondary sources)
teen.holdPermit: 180 days before the road test, unless 18 or older (SCDMV)
teen.nightLimit: Conditional / special restricted license: alone 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. (8 p.m. in daylight saving time); until midnight with a licensed driver 21 or older; midnight to 6 a.m. only with a licensed parent or guardian (secondary sources)
teen.passengerLimit: No more than 2 passengers under 21 unless a licensed adult 21 or older rides along, or they are family or students to or from school (secondary sources)
teen.phone: All drivers: Hands-Free and Distracted Driving Act, 2025, primary offense; tickets after a warning period (secondary sources disagree on the start date, July 1 vs Sept. 1, 2025).

bac.under21: 0.02 (zero tolerance; first offense 3-month suspension, secondary sources)

notes: Permit supervisor: licensed driver 21 or older with at least 1 year of experience; between midnight and 6 a.m. the supervisor must be a parent or guardian (secondary).
Conditional license 15 to 16 after 180 days with the permit; special restricted license 16 to 17 with the same requirements (secondary).
Knowledge test 30 questions, 24 correct (80 percent): third-party sites only, agree with each other. SCDMV: $2.00 test fee, $2.50 permit fee; arrive before 4 p.m.
Move over (SCDPS): slow down and change to a lane not adjacent to a stationary emergency vehicle if possible; otherwise slow to a safe speed.
School bus (SCDPS via news): on a highway with at least 2 lanes each way, opposite-direction traffic need not stop regardless of median; same direction stops.
Rural interstates 70 mph (GHSA). A 45 mph minimum could not be confirmed; not used.

Handbook: an English 2024 manual is archived at dc.statelibrary.sc.gov but the exact record and the SCDMV PDF URL were not confirmed; no Spanish handbook found. Agency site now dmv.sc.gov (scdmvonline.com also seen).
